name: keeplink-mcp
description: Non-blocking web page archiving for AI Agents via the Internet Archive.
author: KeepLink Contributors

tools.name: archive_url
tools.description: Submit a URL for archiving to the Internet Archive. Returns immediately with a task_id.

tools.name: get_archive_status
tools.description: Check the status of an archive task by task_id or URL.

url.description: URL to look up the most recent task for

prerequisites.note: The FastAPI backend service must be running: python -m keeplink_mcp.main
